integrity: An elementary combinatorial proof is supplied, with a standalone verifier. No independent mathematical audit, formal external certification, or publication-priority guarantee is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact labeled counts proved for triangular graphs only; no extension to arbitrary line or Johnson graphs. The maximum dissociation number is a known scalar consequence of Orlovich et al. (2011) and is not presented as new. Publication priority is provisional because inaccessible or differently indexed exact enumerators may exist. Finite verification is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: Dissociation and maximal-dissociation polynomials of triangular graphs
